meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: Claude 先探测你已有的 Mattermost 服务器,找到健康的就复用,否则给出官方部署指引;再复制适配器、注册机器人、配置审批回调并重启,之后 Mattermost 私聊、频道和卡片审批即可接入 NanoClaw。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加 Mattermost 频道(自托管或云端)时接管:先探测可复用的服务器,再引导注册机器人和配置回调。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 Mattermost 频道,先看看有没有可用的服务器
say.note: 会先探测本地和配置里的服务器

say.text: 我的 Mattermost 用户名是 alice,解析它并打开和机器人的私聊
say.note: 会解析用户并创建私聊

howto.what_en: Claude probes for an existing Mattermost server, reuses a healthy one or points to official setup docs, then copies the adapter, registers the bot, configures approval callbacks and restarts so DMs, channels and cards work.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you want to add a Mattermost channel (self-hosted or cloud) to NanoClaw: it discovers a reusable server, then guides bot creation and callback setup.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel and check for any server I already have
say_en.note: Probes local and configured servers first

say_en.text: Use https://mattermost.example.com as the Mattermost server URL
say_en.note: Saves it as the canonical base URL

say_en.text: My Mattermost username is alice; resolve it and open the bot DM
say_en.note: Resolves the user and opens the DM
